name: Matomo
description: Matomo describes itself as "privacy-first analytics you can trust," delivering accurate, GDPR-compliant analytics with full data ownership via self-hosted or cloud deployment.
best_for: Positioned for organizations wanting privacy-compliant analytics without vendor lock-in — enterprises prioritizing data ownership, public sector bodies with regulatory requirements, and teams seeking a Google Analytics alternative.
features: Unsampled data with no sampling limitations
Cookieless tracking and data anonymization options
Self-hosted or cloud deployment with full data ownership
Funnel/flow analysis and raw data export

alternatives.name: Google Analytics
alternatives.description: A free analytics tool from Google measuring customer behavior across websites and apps.
alternatives.best_for: Businesses of every size wanting free, easy measurement unified with Google's ad platforms.

alternatives.name: Hotjar
alternatives.description: An experience-intelligence platform for understanding and improving user behavior on websites/apps.
alternatives.best_for: Product, design, and marketing teams wanting to reduce drop-offs and improve conversion.

pricing.starting_price: On-Premise Community: free; Matomo Cloud starts from $19/month

tiers.name: On-Premise Community
tiers.notes: Free and open source; unlimited users and hits, hosted on your own infrastructure.

tiers.name: Matomo Cloud
tiers.notes: Cloud packages start from $19/month; pricing increases with traffic.

tiers.name: On-Premise paid bundles
tiers.notes: Optional paid bundles and support add advanced features and service levels; pricing varies by bundle and user/hit limits.

tiers.name: Enterprise
tiers.notes: Custom Cloud or On-Premise requirements can be quoted by sales.

cons: The free On-Premise edition requires you to provide and maintain the server, database, updates, backups, and operational security yourself.
Matomo Cloud pricing scales with traffic, while advanced On-Premise capabilities and professional support can require paid bundles or separate subscriptions.
